messages.content: Have you tried checking the connections or power supply when it happens? Sometimes a loose wire or voltage fluctuation can cause intermittent issues.

To address the intermittent nature of the problem, I suggest focusing on the power and connection stability. If you have access to the device's internal wiring, you might want to check for any visible signs of wear, such as frayed wires or loose connections at the main power source or plug. Even a simple, loose connection can often cause a "random" failure that seems sporadic.

Would you be able to inspect the connections for any visible signs of wear, or perhaps a more thorough check of the internal connections?"
I'll start by checking the power cable and outlet, maybe try a different one just in case. If that doesn't help, I'll see if I can get a better look at the connections inside.
Okay, let me know if you find anything that seems off after checking the power source or any of the internal connections. Let me know if changing the outlet helps at all.
I'll give that a try and let you know what I find. If it's not obvious, maybe I'll take a closer look at the back panel.
